slides.title: The first *30 seconds* decide the other thirty minutes
replace: SUBJECT: a giant human EAR alone, built as one blank torn-paper shape. Only the inner whorl is a grainy black-and-white photographic fragment.
COMPOSITION: the ear is huge and cropped by the right edge. Vast empty ink field across the left two thirds.
COLOUR: the ink field is hot magenta pink.
SUBJECT: one tiny torn-paper figure walking away, seen from behind, no face, no detail inside the shape.
COMPOSITION: the figure is very small and pushed into the bottom-right corner. Almost the entire sheet is empty ink.
COLOUR: the ink field is deep orange-red.

slides.title: Nobody stays for the *warm-up*
replace: SUBJECT: a large closed MOUTH shape cut from blank paper, lips pressed shut, no teeth, no interior detail.
COMPOSITION: the mouth sits low and left, cropped by the bottom edge. Empty ink above it.
COLOUR: the ink field is electric blue-violet.
SUBJECT: a scatter of two dozen small blank torn-paper scraps of different sizes, drifting apart.
COMPOSITION: the scraps cluster in the top-right and thin out towards the bottom-left, which stays empty.
COLOUR: the ink field is near-black charcoal.

slides.title: Move your best line to the *top*
replace: SUBJECT: a pair of open scissors as one blank torn-paper silhouette, with a single narrow paper strip falling away beneath them.
COMPOSITION: scissors high and right, the falling strip trailing towards the bottom-left. Empty ink elsewhere.
COLOUR: the ink field is acid lime yellow-green.

slides.title: Start at the *punchline*
replace: SUBJECT: one bold blank torn-paper exclamation stroke — a thick vertical slash with a separate square below it.
COMPOSITION: the stroke stands tall in the right third, cropped by the top edge. The left two thirds are empty ink.
COLOUR: the ink field is hot pink.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: six blank torn-paper rectangles of equal size laid out in a loose grid, nothing inside them.
COMPOSITION: the grid drifts across the whole sheet, slightly rotated, edges cropped by the frame.
COLOUR: the ink field is deep charcoal, almost black.

slides.title: Your cold open, found for you
replace: SUBJECT: a large blank torn-paper triangle pointing right, like a play button, with one grainy black-and-white photographic fragment set into its lower corner.
COMPOSITION: the triangle is centred high, cropped by the top edge, empty ink filling the lower half.
COLOUR: the ink field is acid lime yellow-green.
